parameters.jsCode: const token=String($env.N8N_WEBHOOK_TOKEN||'');if(!token||$input.first().json.headers?.authorization!=='Bearer '+token)throw new Error('Unauthorized');const http=require('http');const status=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const req=http.get('http://tika:9998/version',res=>{res.resume();res.on('end',()=>resolve(res.statusCode));});req.setTimeout(10000,()=>req.destroy(new Error('Tika probe timeout')));req.on('error',reject);});if(status!==200)throw new Error('Tika not ready');return [{json:{external_runner_executed:true,tika_http_status:status,ingestion_started:false}}];
